title: Welcome to Burst-wise FCS
text: This tool correlates photons within isolated single-molecule bursts to extract diffusion coefficients and photophysical kinetics without bulk bias.

title: Correlator Settings
text: Configure linear bins per cascade, cascade tier depth, and optional burst padding in milliseconds.

title: Run Correlation
text: Press Run FCS to compute autocorrelation and cross-correlation curves across configured detector pairs.

title: Inspect Curves & Gating
text: Review the multi-tau correlation curves G(τ) and adjust interactive time-gate boundaries directly on the plot.
